title: Wire math parser into frontend/__init__.py pipeline
objective: Plumb math_parser into the top-level frontend pipeline so $...$ blocks reach the symbolic layer via the bridge.

plan_assets.asset_description: Performance risk: only invoke math parser for $...$ blocks; directive-only files skip

scope: Detect $...$ math blocks in input LaTeX
Route math blocks to math_parser → bridge → symbolic
implementation_steps: Identify current frontend entry point and parse loop
Add $...$ block detection (regex or LaTeX tokenizer)
On match, call math_parser then bridge
Skip math parsing entirely if no $...$ block in input
Smoke test: directive-only file path unchanged
deliverables: Smoke test confirming directive-only path is untouched
acceptance_criteria: Math-bearing LaTeX produces a populated symbolic expression tree
Directive-only LaTeX skips math parsing entirely (verified by mock or import counter)
No regression in existing frontend tests
verification_commands: uv run pytest -m "not slow and not gpu" --tb=line -q
risks: Regex-based detection of $...$ may misfire with verbatim/escape — mitigation: use established LaTeX tokenizer if nrpylatex provides one
completion_notes: Math-block regex skips %-comment lines (post-P4-5 fix; was over-matching prose).
% declare lines extracted from source and prepended to each $...$ block before nrpylatex parse.
Parse-when-needed guard verified by monkeypatch: directive-only inputs do not invoke math_parser.parse_math.
Local imports keep directive-only path off math parser dependency chain.
